title: Astro Portal session event payload: mount_link_back
description: The link to the mount is up again after a `mount_link_lost`, read only: the application reads the mount and never resumes a slew. A reader pairs it with the previous `mount_link_lost` to say how long the link was down. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

protocol.description: Optional: the mount's protocol as the application names it (`LX200`, `Alpaca`, `INDI`, `SynScan`, `iOptron`, `NexStar`).
